title: The derived unit on a literal single complex
statement: Let B be Grothendieck abelian and C abelian, both with chosen derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let G : B → C be additive and left exact. Let X be an object of B and n a natural number. Let S be the literal single complex on X in degree n, e : single_n X ≅ Q S the canonical singleFunctorIsoCompQ followed by the inverse quotientCompQhIso lifted to the bounded-below derived category, and GS = G(S). Then homologyπ(GS,n), followed by homologyFunctorObjQIso(GS,n) inverse, H^n of the right-derived unit on S, H^n(RG(e inverse)), and the hom component of [def-pc-right-derived-single-degree-comparison] at X, equals iCycles(GS,n) followed by G of the sole-term identification S.X n ≅ X.
